decisions.reason: The message's separate basket-weave selection and screenshot-detail instruction are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the Zebra direction and colour change do not otherwise alter the basket-weave Requirement.
Selecting the Zebra Savanna direction and requesting less yellow or gold does not change the deferred terracotta block-colour pareo or its colour and border requirements.
The Zebra-specific selection and tonal adjustment do not change the deferred mustard block-colour pareo or its mustard interior and black border.
The Zebra design and colour-direction selection does not alter the production-ready file standard, print method, fabric, CMYK preparation, Pantone workflow, or ICC-profile requirement.
